evidence: apps/runtime-worker/src/main.ts parses CREWON_WORKER_CONCURRENCY with default 2 unless CREWON_WORKER_ONCE is set.
apps/crewon-ui/src/lib/control-runtime/controlThreadRuntime.ts applies focus only in #ensureThreadEventStream; #ensureEventStream maintains Run streams independently.
apps/runtime-worker/src/runtime-worker-pool.integration.test.ts covers two active Runs, sibling cancellation, close join and queue refill.
limitations: The verification uses controlled model transport and isolated SQLite.
It does not measure a packaged desktop renderer or a real provider.
It does not prove that every UI surface renders background completion without a refresh.
